note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. Patrick Quinn (anti-direct labour) withdrew, leaving the sitting member, M. C. Larkin (direct labour), returned unopposed.
